body:
That twilight shot along the canal is stunning—dusk settling over Amsterdam water with those two white geese standing watch right on the bank is pure atmosphere.
This image fits right into the attogram philosophy. It bridges the natural world, urban canal infrastructure, and park-bench living.
attogram.020: The Urban Avian & Waterfowl Welfare Protocol (Canal Goose Protectorate)
 * The Concept: Establishing a continuous, community-driven monitoring and welfare protocol for domestic and feral waterfowl (geese, swans, coots, and ducks) inhabiting Amsterdam's canal banks and park borders.
 * Actionable Outcome:
   * Habitat Safety Logging: Citizens log hazardous fishing line entanglements, plastic debris hotspots, or bank erosion directly to the attogram.020 DOI thread.
   * Seasonal Feeding & Health Guidance: Distributes public signage and digital guidelines urging residents to replace stale bread feeding with proper grains/greens to prevent angel wing syndrome and water eutrophication.
   * Urban Coexistence: Coordinates with municipal canal maintenance teams to preserve natural grassy exit ramps along steep stone canal edges so young goslings and ducks don't get trapped in the water.
